title: Tectonic official website
notes: First-party source establishing Tectonic's protocol identity and official domain. This source is not used by itself to establish the exploit amount or final incident cause.

title: Cronos network halts after Tectonic exploit estimated at USD 75 million
notes: Contemporaneous coverage of the exploit estimate, approximately USD 6 million bridged before the halt, and the absence of a final Tectonic-confirmed amount/root cause at publication time.

title: Cronos halts blockchain after USD 75 million lending exploit hits Tectonic
notes: Independent corroboration of the estimated incident size, TONIC price-manipulation narrative and Cronos halt while preserving uncertainty around final losses and restart/remediation.

title: Tectonic exploited on Cronos for estimated USD 75 million as validators halt network
notes: Corroborates that Tectonic acknowledged an incident and that the reported USD 75 million figure and root-cause explanation remained preliminary rather than a final post-mortem conclusion.

title: Cronos halts entire blockchain after Tectonic exploit; only part of funds bridge out
notes: Corroborates the distinction between approximately USD 6 million bridged away and larger exploit-linked balances remaining on Cronos. Frozen or stranded balances are not treated as recovered.
